retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait against a dark background featuring vibrant red hand-drawn script lettering angled in the upper corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man with curly hair wearing a plaid shirt and vest, framed by expressive, diagonal red handwriting against a near-black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast dark void
Vibrant red text providing a color pop against muted clothing tones
Diagonal text orientation framing the subject's head
Warm skin tones balanced by cool blue denim and multi-colored plaid
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn script style with consistent stroke weight
Diagonal upward tilt of all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and smile, centered in the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left script, move down to the face, and then up to the top-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper third and surrounding the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black/brown background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red used exclusively for the graphic text elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-colored plaid (orange, blue, yellow) in the clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright red text and skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit text to a single primary red hue

letterConstructionRules: Uniform line weight suggesting a felt-tip marker
Rapid, gestural strokes with sharp terminals
Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated capital initials
characterSpecificRedesigns: Underlining strokes that extend from the final letter of words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style gestural script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, signed feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, felt-tip pen aesthetic of the original.
Matches the personal, 'autographed' look of the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style studio portrait of a man with curly hair, wearing a plaid shirt and a dark vest, centered against a solid dark brown or black background with soft lighting on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, gestural script in bright red ink. Position the text in the top left and top right corners, tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle, with long underlines extending from the words.

verificationChecks: Is the text angled diagonally upwards?
Is the background dark and uncluttered?
Does the lettering look like marker handwriting?

mustAchieve: High contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the plaid pattern feels period-accurate to the 1970s.
Check that the background is sufficiently dark to make the red pop.
Confirm the handwriting has a consistent 'marker' thickness.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered 70s portrait + dark void background + diagonal red marker script in corners.
